title: Release 0.9.2: version bump, promote, release.yml publish:false for e2e qualification, then publish on the user's approval
description: 0.9.2 ships LCLI-573 (#237, retrieval-first agent guidance). The sequence follows the OPAG-378 05:15Z orchestrator ruling and opum-cli-e2e's 2026-09-24 request. (1) Bump to 0.9.2 on dev as one version-metadata commit, the same recipe as #234. (2) Promote to main. (3) Dispatch release.yml with publish:false at that SHA and send the run id to opum-cli-e2e. (4) e2e qualifies those exact npm-packages tarballs and sends a receipt with the SHA, the run id and each tarball's sha256. (5) Publishing those bytes is the user's decision. (6) After publish, give opum-marketplace the tag, the tag object, the peeled commit and the skills/ tree SHA, in two messages (LCLI-469). LCLI-575 does not land on dev until the bump is cut, so the qualified SHA stays the release SHA.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Bump commit on dev covers every version site #234 touched, with bun test, typecheck, lint and bun run lore check green on its PR run
dev promoted to main at the bump SHA as a fast-forward
release.yml run with publish:false at that SHA is green; run id sent to opum-cli-e2e
opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt received and recorded here (SHA, run id, tarball digests)
Publication decided by the user; if published, registry latest=0.9.2 on all seven packages and marketplace handshake sent

implementationNotes: Progress 2026-09-24. AC1: bump #242. The PR run on its head was green, and the promotion PR #244 check-runs on 71f2c1e4 were all green except promotion-is-manual (red by design). AC2: main fast-forwarded ecb9748c->71f2c1e470aac36465871652ddf5347d5b0382c0 by git push origin origin/dev:main, trees equal to origin/dev, and #244 auto-marked MERGED. AC3: release.yml run 35961511364 (workflow_dispatch, publish=false, head 71f2c1e4) succeeded. All six matching-host package qualifications and the package+install-sanity dry-run were green; publish was skipped. Artifacts expire 2026-12-23. Publication path: scripts/publish-release.sh 0.9.2 35961511364, which re-verifies each sha256 before publishing (no rebuild). Waiting on e2e's receipt (AC4), then the user's decision (AC5).
